card.name: Words before inner or core qualities
card.fires_on: Small words like "the", "your", or "'s" right before a word about inner, personal or core nature, such as internal heat, soul-level focus or self-healing. Also appears in Hindu text before an age or deity name.

modes.label: Your/the before inner terms

modes.label: Hindu myth lists
modes.description: An article or name start inside lists of ages, gods or kings.
modes.example: Brahma is the Creator, Vishnu<< the>> Preserver, Siva the Transformer.
